rate_plans_charge_value_check.name: rate_plans_charge_value_check
rate_plans_charge_value_check.value:
("rate_plans"."cancel_charge" = 'percent'
             AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" IS NOT NULL
             AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("rate_plans"."cancel_charge" <> 'percent' AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" IS NULL)

rate_plans_no_show_value_check.name: rate_plans_no_show_value_check
rate_plans_no_show_value_check.value:
("rate_plans"."no_show_charge" = 'percent'
             AND "rate_plans"."no_show_charge_value" IS NOT NULL
             AND "rate_plans"."no_show_charge_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("rate_plans"."no_show_charge" IS DISTINCT FROM 'percent' AND "rate_plans"."no_show_charge_value" IS NULL)

rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check.name: rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check
rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check.value: "rate_plan_rates"."min_stay" IS NULL OR "rate_plan_rates"."max_stay" IS NULL OR "rate_plan_rates"."max_stay" >= "rate_plan_rates"."min_stay"

bookings_no_show_value_check.name: bookings_no_show_value_check
bookings_no_show_value_check.value:
("bookings"."no_show_charge" = 'percent'
             AND "bookings"."no_show_charge_value" IS NOT NULL
             AND "bookings"."no_show_charge_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("bookings"."no_show_charge" IS DISTINCT FROM 'percent' AND "bookings"."no_show_charge_value" IS NULL)

bookings_cancellation_consistency.name: bookings_cancellation_consistency
bookings_cancellation_consistency.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "bookings"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "bookings"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

bookings_hold_consistency.name: bookings_hold_consistency
bookings_hold_consistency.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'pending' AND "bookings"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'pending' AND "bookings"."hold_expires_at" IS NULL)

reviews_response_consistency.name: reviews_response_consistency
reviews_response_consistency.value:
("reviews"."response_text" IS NULL AND "reviews"."response_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("reviews"."response_text" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."response_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_one_live_primary.name: payments_one_live_primary
payments_one_live_primary.where: kind IN ('charge', 'guarantee') AND status NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled')

payments_captured_consistency.name: payments_captured_consistency
payments_captured_consistency.value:
("payments"."status" IN ('captured', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded') AND "payments"."captured_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("payments"."status" NOT IN ('captured', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded') AND "payments"."captured_at" IS NULL)

payouts_paid_consistency.name: payouts_paid_consistency
payouts_paid_consistency.value:
("payouts"."status" = 'paid' AND "payouts"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("payouts"."status" <> 'paid' AND "payouts"."paid_at" IS NULL)
